services.name: Fishing Spots
services.desc: Experience the perfect balance between inshore calm and offshore adventure with Fort Myers nearshore fishing charters. If you’re looking for action-packed fishing just off the coast, Sea n Red Charters offers the best nearshore fishing adventures in Fort Myers. These trips take you 3-9 miles from shore, targeting reefs, wrecks, and ledges where grouper, snapper, kingfish, cobia, and even sharks roam. It’s the ideal blend of accessibility and excitement-without the long offshore ride.Our licensed captain provides top-quality gear, local expertise, and a comfortable, family-friendly experience on every trip.
